title: The truth about bats - Amy Wray
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】關於蝙蝠的真相 - 艾米雷（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Flying through the night, I watch over this world, a silent guardian, a watchful protector, a dark knight, I'm...
cues.en: Flying through the night, I watch over this world, a silent guardian, a watchful protector, a dark knight, I'm...
cues.zh: 飛翔在夜空之中，我守護著世界， 一名沉默的守衛、警覺的捍衛者、 黑暗的騎士，我就是.... 好啦好啦！我不是蝙蝠俠 我不過就是隻蝙蝠。

cues.text: Okay, fine. So, I'm not Batman. I'm just a bat.
cues.en: Okay, fine. So, I'm not Batman. I'm just a bat.
cues.zh: 好啦好啦！我不是蝙蝠俠 我不過就是隻蝙蝠。 不過就像蝙蝠俠一樣，我總是受人誤會，

cues.text: But like Batman, I'm often misunderstood.
cues.en: But like Batman, I'm often misunderstood.
cues.zh: 好啦好啦！我不是蝙蝠俠 我不過就是隻蝙蝠。 不過就像蝙蝠俠一樣，我總是受人誤會，

cues.text: People think I'm scary, strange and dangerous.
cues.en: People think I'm scary, strange and dangerous.
cues.zh: 不過就像蝙蝠俠一樣，我總是受人誤會， 人們認為我是可怕、詭異、危險的，

cues.text: If they only knew my story, though, I'd be cheered as a hero.
cues.en: If they only knew my story, though, I'd be cheered as a hero.
cues.zh: 人們認為我是可怕、詭異、危險的， 只要他們曉得了我的功蹟， 我將會被當成英雄受人仰頌。

cues.text: When people think of bats, many think of vampires who want to suck their blood.
cues.en: When people think of bats, many think of vampires who want to suck their blood.
cues.zh: 只要他們曉得了我的功蹟， 我將會被當成英雄受人仰頌。 當人們想起蝙蝠時， 許多人就想到 打算吸他們血的吸血鬼，

cues.text: But the truth is that out of over 1200 bat species, only three are vampire bats.
cues.en: But the truth is that out of over 1200 bat species, only three are vampire bats.
cues.zh: 許多人就想到 打算吸他們血的吸血鬼， 但是真相是：世上超過1,200個品種， 其中只有3種是吸血蝙蝠，

cues.text: Out of these three, only one prefers the blood of mammals, and even these bats mostly feed on cattle.
cues.en: Out of these three, only one prefers the blood of mammals, and even these bats mostly feed on cattle.
cues.zh: 當中又只有1種嗜吸哺乳類的血， 而牠們大多也只是吸牛血而已，

cues.text: Maybe that still doesn't seem so great, but vampire bats can be a great help to humans.
cues.en: Maybe that still doesn't seem so great, but vampire bats can be a great help to humans.
cues.zh: 而牠們大多也只是吸牛血而已， 也許那聽起來也算不上什麼好事； 但吸血蝙蝠能變得對人類極為有益，

cues.text: A chemical known as desmoteplase found in vampire bat saliva
cues.en: A chemical known as desmoteplase found in vampire bat saliva
cues.zh: 在蝙蝠唾液裡發現名為 「去氨普酶」的化學物質 有助於溶解血栓，

cues.text: helps break down blood clots, and is being tested by recovering stroke victims.
cues.en: helps break down blood clots, and is being tested by recovering stroke victims.
cues.zh: 有助於溶解血栓， 已被測試來治療中風患者。 其他一千多種蝙蝠大約有 70%是以昆蟲為食，

cues.text: Of the remaining 1000+ species of bats, about 70% feed on insects.
cues.en: Of the remaining 1000+ species of bats, about 70% feed on insects.
cues.zh: 已被測試來治療中風患者。 其他一千多種蝙蝠大約有 70%是以昆蟲為食，

cues.text: These bats help control the real vampires: mosquitos, whose nasty bites are not just annoying
cues.en: These bats help control the real vampires: mosquitos, whose nasty bites are not just annoying
cues.zh: 這些蝙蝠有助於管控 真正的吸血鬼「蚊子」， 其令人討厭的叮咬不僅煩人， 還會散佈像是西尼羅病毒之類的疾病，

cues.text: but spread diseases, like West Nile virus.
cues.en: but spread diseases, like West Nile virus.
cues.zh: 其令人討厭的叮咬不僅煩人， 還會散佈像是西尼羅病毒之類的疾病，

cues.text: A single little brown bat can eat 1000 insects every hour,
cues.en: A single little brown bat can eat 1000 insects every hour,
cues.zh: 一隻小型棕蝠每小時 能吃掉1000隻昆蟲， 一群墨西哥遊離尾蝠一個晚上

cues.text: and a colony of Mexican free-tailed bats can eat several tons of moths
cues.en: and a colony of Mexican free-tailed bats can eat several tons of moths
cues.zh: 一隻小型棕蝠每小時 能吃掉1000隻昆蟲， 一群墨西哥遊離尾蝠一個晚上

cues.text: in just one night.
cues.en: in just one night.
cues.zh: 就可以吃掉數噸重之飛蛾。 單單在美國，

cues.text: In the United States alone, bats provide an estimated 3.7 billion dollars worth
cues.en: In the United States alone, bats provide an estimated 3.7 billion dollars worth
cues.zh: 就可以吃掉數噸重之飛蛾。 單單在美國， 蝙蝠貢獻給農人們估計有 37億美元價值之不收費害蟲控制，

cues.text: of free pest control for farmers, which benefits everyone who eats the foods that they grow.
cues.en: of free pest control for farmers, which benefits everyone who eats the foods that they grow.
cues.zh: 37億美元價值之不收費害蟲控制， 嘉惠到食用這些食物的每一個人。 果蝠因為牠們的大尺寸 而被稱為巨蝠，

cues.text: Fruit bats, also called megabats because of their large size,
cues.en: Fruit bats, also called megabats because of their large size,
cues.zh: 果蝠因為牠們的大尺寸 而被稱為巨蝠，

cues.text: are important for the role they play in plant pollination.
cues.en: are important for the role they play in plant pollination.
cues.zh: 果蝠因為牠們的大尺寸 而被稱為巨蝠， 牠們在授粉上扮演重要的角色， 當覓食花蜜和果實時， 藉由在花朵間遊走，

cues.text: By traveling between flowers while feeding on nectar and fruits, these bats transport the pollen and seeds that help plants reproduce.
cues.en: By traveling between flowers while feeding on nectar and fruits, these bats transport the pollen and seeds that help plants reproduce.
cues.zh: 當覓食花蜜和果實時， 藉由在花朵間遊走， 這些蝙蝠運送花粉和種子， 幫助植物繁衍，

cues.text: In Southeast Asia, for example, the cave nectar bat is the only pollinator of the durian fruit.
cues.en: In Southeast Asia, for example, the cave nectar bat is the only pollinator of the durian fruit.
cues.zh: 這些蝙蝠運送花粉和種子， 幫助植物繁衍， 以東南亞而說， 長舌果蝠是榴槤唯一的授粉者，

cues.text: Other bats pollinate peaches, bananas, and the agave plants that tequila is made from.
cues.en: Other bats pollinate peaches, bananas, and the agave plants that tequila is made from.
cues.zh: 其他蝙蝠授粉給桃子、香蕉， 以及用來製造龍舌蘭酒的龍舌蘭花，

cues.text: Without them, many of our food plants would be unable to produce the tasty fruits we enjoy.
cues.en: Without them, many of our food plants would be unable to produce the tasty fruits we enjoy.
cues.zh: 以及用來製造龍舌蘭酒的龍舌蘭花， 要不是牠們，許多食用植物就 無法長出我們喜愛的美味水果。

cues.text: As heroes of the ecosystem, bats have their own unique utility belts.
cues.en: As heroes of the ecosystem, bats have their own unique utility belts.
cues.zh: 要不是牠們，許多食用植物就 無法長出我們喜愛的美味水果。 身為生態系統中的英雄， 蝙蝠配備了獨特的工具腰帶。

cues.text: Bats have been a source of inspiration for the design of flying robots and even an energy-efficient spy plane,
cues.en: Bats have been a source of inspiration for the design of flying robots and even an energy-efficient spy plane,
cues.zh: 身為生態系統中的英雄， 蝙蝠配備了獨特的工具腰帶。 蝙蝠向來都是設計飛行機器人、 甚至是低耗電偵察機的靈感來源， 因為牠們是唯一能靠 自身的力量飛行的哺乳類。

cues.text: as they are the only mammal capable of true powered flight.
cues.en: as they are the only mammal capable of true powered flight.
cues.zh: 因為牠們是唯一能靠 自身的力量飛行的哺乳類。 「回聲定位」是一種生物性聲納，

cues.text: Echolocation, a type of biological sonar, is also used by bats as a way to navigate
cues.en: Echolocation, a type of biological sonar, is also used by bats as a way to navigate
cues.zh: 「回聲定位」是一種生物性聲納， 也是被蝙蝠用來導航 及黑暗中尋找獵物。

cues.text: and find prey in the dark.
cues.en: and find prey in the dark.
cues.zh: 也是被蝙蝠用來導航 及黑暗中尋找獵物。 儘管有一種普遍的錯誤觀念， 認為蝙蝠看不見，

cues.text: Although there's a common misconception that bats are blind, in truth, all species of bats have sight.
cues.en: Although there's a common misconception that bats are blind, in truth, all species of bats have sight.
cues.zh: 儘管有一種普遍的錯誤觀念， 認為蝙蝠看不見， 事實上各種蝙蝠都有視力， 而且有些甚至還演化成大眼睛， 能在微弱的光線下看得更清楚。

cues.text: And some have even adapted large eyes to see better in dim lighting.
cues.en: And some have even adapted large eyes to see better in dim lighting.
cues.zh: 而且有些甚至還演化成大眼睛， 能在微弱的光線下看得更清楚。 許多人擔心受到蝙蝠的感染，

cues.text: Many people worry about getting infected by bats, and like any other animals, bats can carry diseases, like rabies.
cues.en: Many people worry about getting infected by bats, and like any other animals, bats can carry diseases, like rabies.
cues.zh: 許多人擔心受到蝙蝠的感染， 就像其他動物一樣，蝙蝠有可能帶有 像是狂犬病之類的疾病， 即便如此，事實上只有少於0.5% 的蝙蝠帶有狂犬病病毒，

cues.text: In reality, though, less than .5% of all bats carry this virus.
cues.en: In reality, though, less than .5% of all bats carry this virus.
cues.zh: 即便如此，事實上只有少於0.5% 的蝙蝠帶有狂犬病病毒，

cues.text: That's about the same odds as getting the same result on a coin flip eight times in a row.
cues.en: That's about the same odds as getting the same result on a coin flip eight times in a row.
cues.zh: 即便如此，事實上只有少於0.5% 的蝙蝠帶有狂犬病病毒， 那約是連續八次投擲硬幣， 出現同一面的機率。

cues.text: The perception that bats are often diseased may come from the fact that sick bats,
cues.en: The perception that bats are often diseased may come from the fact that sick bats,
cues.zh: 出現同一面的機率。 蝙蝠總是帶有疾病的認知 可能來自於病變的蝙蝠，

cues.text: who may show unusual behavior, emerge during the daytime, or be unable to fly,
cues.en: who may show unusual behavior, emerge during the daytime, or be unable to fly,
cues.zh: 可能來自於病變的蝙蝠， 這些蝙蝠表現出異常的行為， 像是在白天的時候現蹤 或是無法飛行，

cues.text: are more likely to be encountered by people.
cues.en: are more likely to be encountered by people.
cues.zh: 或是無法飛行， 就比較可能會被人們撞見。 所以保護自己的方法 也連同可保護蝙蝠，

cues.text: So a good way to protect yourself is to protect bats as well,
cues.en: So a good way to protect yourself is to protect bats as well,
cues.zh: 所以保護自己的方法 也連同可保護蝙蝠， 那就是：讓牠們健康並保護其棲地，

cues.text: keeping them healthy, protecting their habitats, and reducing their risk of transmitting disease.
cues.en: keeping them healthy, protecting their habitats, and reducing their risk of transmitting disease.
cues.zh: 那就是：讓牠們健康並保護其棲地， 還有減少牠們傳播疾病的風險。 在北美，蝙蝠受到滅絕性疾病

cues.text: In North America, bats are threatened by a devastating sickness called white-nose syndrome.
cues.en: In North America, bats are threatened by a devastating sickness called white-nose syndrome.
cues.zh: 在北美，蝙蝠受到滅絕性疾病 白鼻症的威脅，

cues.text: This fungal infection causes bats to wake up while hibernating during a winter.
cues.en: This fungal infection causes bats to wake up while hibernating during a winter.
cues.zh: 這種真菌感染導致 蝙蝠在冬眠時甦醒，

cues.text: Unable to find food, they expend large amounts of energy, and eventually starve to death.
cues.en: Unable to find food, they expend large amounts of energy, and eventually starve to death.
cues.zh: 這種真菌感染導致 蝙蝠在冬眠時甦醒， 無法發現食物又耗費大量的體力， 而最終就因為飢餓死掉了；

cues.text: White-nose syndrome has wiped out entire caves full of bats, with a mortality rate that can exceed 90%.
cues.en: White-nose syndrome has wiped out entire caves full of bats, with a mortality rate that can exceed 90%.
cues.zh: 而最終就因為飢餓死掉了； 白鼻症可以滅絕掉 整個洞穴裡的蝙蝠， 死亡率高於90%以上。

cues.text: Climate change and habitat destruction also pose serious threats to bat populations.
cues.en: Climate change and habitat destruction also pose serious threats to bat populations.
cues.zh: 死亡率高於90%以上。 氣候異變和棲息地破壞， 也對蝙蝠的族群帶來嚴重的威脅，

cues.text: For example, in January 2014, a record heat wave in Australia
cues.en: For example, in January 2014, a record heat wave in Australia
cues.zh: 例如澳洲2014年1月 一個創歷史紀錄的熱浪，

cues.text: caused over 100,000 bats to die from heat exhaustion.
cues.en: caused over 100,000 bats to die from heat exhaustion.
cues.zh: 例如澳洲2014年1月 一個創歷史紀錄的熱浪， 造成超過10萬隻蝙蝠 因高溫而死亡，

cues.text: Some people just want to watch the world burn, and bats all over the world are threatened by damage to the places that we call home,
cues.en: Some people just want to watch the world burn, and bats all over the world are threatened by damage to the places that we call home,
cues.zh: 有人就是想看到世界燃燒起來； 全世界的蝙蝠都受到 棲息地破壞的威脅， 包括了紅樹林沼地、原始森林、

cues.text: including mangrove swamps, old-growth forests, and, of course, bat caves.
cues.en: including mangrove swamps, old-growth forests, and, of course, bat caves.
cues.zh: 全世界的蝙蝠都受到 棲息地破壞的威脅， 包括了紅樹林沼地、原始森林、 當然了還有蝙蝠洞穴。

cues.text: So even though I'm the hero of the story, I do need to be saved.
cues.en: So even though I'm the hero of the story, I do need to be saved.
cues.zh: 因此即便我是這故事裡的英雄， 我也需要被人拯救， 現在你曉得了我們的真實故事，

cues.text: And now that you know the true story about us bats, you can learn how to protect such heroic animals.
cues.en: And now that you know the true story about us bats, you can learn how to protect such heroic animals.
cues.zh: 現在你曉得了我們的真實故事， 你可以學習如何來保護 這種英雄般的動物， 設定一個設計完善的蝙蝠箱子，

cues.text: Install a properly designed bat box, one of the easiest ways to provide shelter for bats.
cues.en: Install a properly designed bat box, one of the easiest ways to provide shelter for bats.
cues.zh: 你可以學習如何來保護 這種英雄般的動物， 設定一個設計完善的蝙蝠箱子， 最簡單的方式提供蝙蝠住所。 勸人不要使用殺蟲劑， 那是會傷害到蝙蝠，

cues.text: Discourage the use of pesticides, which can harm bats when we try to feed on the insects you want to get rid of in the first place.
cues.en: Discourage the use of pesticides, which can harm bats when we try to feed on the insects you want to get rid of in the first place.
cues.zh: 勸人不要使用殺蟲劑， 那是會傷害到蝙蝠， 當有人想吃昆蟲時會馬上回絕。 避免進入洞穴裡面， 你可能會侵擾到正在冬眠的蝙蝠，

cues.text: Avoid going into caves where you might disturb hibernating bats,
cues.en: Avoid going into caves where you might disturb hibernating bats,
cues.zh: 避免進入洞穴裡面， 你可能會侵擾到正在冬眠的蝙蝠， 還有在參觀洞穴之後 務必消毒你裝備。

cues.text: and always decontaminate your gear after visiting a cave.
cues.en: and always decontaminate your gear after visiting a cave.
cues.zh: 還有在參觀洞穴之後 務必消毒你裝備。

cues.text: If you have unwanted bats living in an attic or barn, contact your local government to safely and humanely relocate us.
cues.en: If you have unwanted bats living in an attic or barn, contact your local government to safely and humanely relocate us.
cues.zh: 假如在閣樓或糧倉有不請自來的蝙蝠， 聯絡當地政府機關 來安全、人道地重新安置我們，

cues.text: And if you come across a bat, do not attempt to handle it, but instead, call Animal Control.
cues.en: And if you come across a bat, do not attempt to handle it, but instead, call Animal Control.
cues.zh: 聯絡當地政府機關 來安全、人道地重新安置我們， 如果你遇到蝙蝠的話不要抓它， 改以打個電話給動物管制局。

cues.text: Batman might want to keep his identity secret, but a great way to help real bats is by continuing to learn about them
cues.en: Batman might want to keep his identity secret, but a great way to help real bats is by continuing to learn about them
cues.zh: 改以打個電話給動物管制局。 蝙蝠俠可能想要 保持他的身分不為人知， 但是幫助真正的蝙蝠的最佳辦法 則是透過持續地認識牠們，

cues.text: and spreading the truth that they are real heroes,
cues.en: and spreading the truth that they are real heroes,
cues.zh: 以及傳達牠們真正的英雄事實， 即便牠們總是善行不為人知。

cues.text: even if their good deeds are often unseen.
cues.en: even if their good deeds are often unseen.
cues.zh: 即便牠們總是善行不為人知。
